reason: S1 adds the selectable EVM configuration Amsterdam, but H0 can map Program_Version only through Program::OSAKA. Consequently, S1 + H0 cannot generate programs configured with EVMVersion::amsterdam(), leaving the newly added version-specific configuration surface unreachable. This gap did not exist in S0 because Amsterdam was introduced by this commit.
evidence: EVMVersion adds the public factory EVMVersion::amsterdam().
EVMVersion::allVersions() adds amsterdam(), making it part of the enumerated version set used by fromString().
The private Version enum adds Amsterdam between Osaka and Future.
ProtoConverter::evmVersionMapping(Program_Version const&) has cases from Program::HOMESTEAD through Program::OSAKA but no Amsterdam case.
ProtoConverter::visit(Program const&) sets m_evmVersion exclusively through evmVersionMapping(_x.ver()).
recommended_action: Extend the harness input version protocol with an Amsterdam value and add a corresponding Program::AMSTERDAM case in ProtoConverter::evmVersionMapping() returning EVMVersion::amsterdam().
